notes.title: Devlog 01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Here's 42Teaparty, developer of Just a Chest.

Thank you all for your patience and support for Just a Chest. Now the game is still in progress and has entered the late stage of production. Also, multi-language localization of the game is in progress. Last month, Just a Chest was exhibited at TGS. We sincerely hope there'll be more opportunities to meet you all at different exhibitions in the future. Can't wait to see you play the game and hear your comments!
 
Now the Japanese version of the store page is officially released. We'll continue to develop the game while polishing its localization versions, and keep you updated about the news of Just a Chest. See you soon.

Here are some art from the game, hope you like them:

notes.title: Upcoming indie RPG says forget about looting treasure chests—now you are one
notes.notes: RPG fans have been eating good this year. Even setting aside monster releases like Baldur's Gate 3, Starfield, and the second coming of Johnny Silverhand, there are tons of great games on Steam vying for our leftover attention. But only one of them lets you play as a treasure chest... Read more.
